figures.finding: From 1 July 2021 an individual or sole trader pays nothing on the first TOP 12,000 a year, 10% to 30,000, 15% to 50,000, 20% to 70,000 and 25% above, as the Ministry of Revenue and Customs announced; no later change was found.
figures.applies: Individuals and sole traders in Tonga; financial year 1 July - 30 June (2025-26 and 2026-27 touch calendar 2026), on the 2021 schedule.

sources.said: The tax-free income level will be raised from the first $10,000 to the first $12,000 pa'anga earned in the new financial year, with further adjustments in tax thresholds easing higher income tax levels.

The current 10% income tax will be applied on income between $12,000 and $30,000 per annum. For earnings between $30,001 and $50,000, the rate will be reduced from 20% to 15%. Earnings between $50,0001 and $70,000 are subject to a $20% tax rate. Earnings over $70,001 are subject to a 25% tax rate.
Income tax cuts for individuals and sole traders from July 1 means all income taxpayers in Tonga will pay less.

sources.title: Income tax cuts for individuals and sole traders from July 1 (Matangi Tonga, 13 May 2021), quoting the Ministry of Revenue and Customs
sources.said: The tax-free income level will be raised from the first $10,000 to the first $12,000 pa'anga earned in the new financial year, with further adjustments in tax thresholds easing higher income tax levels. … The current 10% income tax will be applied on income between $12,000 and $30,000 per annum. For earnings between $30,001 and $50,000, the rate will be reduced from 20% to 15%. Earnings between $50,0001 and $70,000 are subject to a $20% tax rate. Earnings over $70,001 are subject to a 25% tax rate. … Income tax cuts for individuals and sole traders from July 1 means all income taxpayers in Tonga will pay less.
